title: Refactor toolbar pillset interaction landmarks & contrast presets
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Audit and refactor the 'pillset' / toolbar chip patterns across the component library to standardize ARIA roles, focus landmarks, keyboard traversal, and high-contrast token mappings. This work targets toolbar action groups used in dense lists, table toolbars, and compact chart controls where current focus order and contrast ratios are inconsistent and occasionally fail automated VPAT checks.
background: Multiple product teams reported inconsistent keyboard behavior for toolbar pillsets: focus sometimes lands on non-interactive wrapper elements; shift+tab order is surprising for nested filter groups; and color tokens for selected/inactive pills regress below 4.5:1 in dark themes. Engineering flagged related bugs ENG-63344 and ENG-63802 where KV cache of keyboard bindings caused duplicate focusable nodes in some builds.
acceptance_criteria: All toolbar pillset instances use a consistent ARIA pattern (role=toolbar where applicable, role=group for grouped chips, aria-pressed for toggle pills)
Keyboard navigation linearizes (left/right / arrow keys) consistently and supports home/end for wrapping toolbars
Focus rings are visible across themes and meet a11y contrast guidance; tokens for selected/hover/disabled meet WCAG 2.1 AA (4.5:1) in default and high-contrast themes
Provide three reference examples in the component docs (single-row toolbar, multi-row collapsed toolbar, nested group with overflow) with code sandbox and axe snapshot
VPAT evidence added to the accessibility package for toolbar/pillset patterns (test plan, screenshots, screenreader transcripts)
Design token migration guide included and coordinated with frontend rollout (migration flags and fallback token mapping)
tasks: Inventory every component that renders a pill/chip used in toolbars (explorer: table toolbar, chart overlay, list actions)
Propose ARIA pattern and keyboard model in Figma + design doc
Update tokens: add high-contrast variants and deprecate color-weak tokens with mapping table
Implement accessible examples and a11y unit tests (axe/puppeteer) in the component repo
Coordinate with frontend on canary rollout and flag-based migration
Assemble VPAT annex for the toolbar component set with test artifacts
qa_checklist: Run axe-core on each reference example and attach reports
Keyboard-only walkthrough video for desktop and laptop resolutions
Screenreader transcripts (NVDA, VoiceOver) for each example
Contrast checks for all token combos in light/dark/high-contrast themes
notes: We need to avoid changing public class names used by downstream customers. Prefer feature flags and token aliasing for migration. Engineering advised a two-week staggered rollout to catch layout regressions (see ENG-63802). Design will add visual testcases to Percy.
